text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
Haa... It was tough, but this is the last one, it seems.
If we've come this far, we must win no matter what...!
With me and everyone from the Alces Atelier, we can surely do it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
しぶとかったけど、
これが最後みたい。
ここまで来たら
絶対に勝ち切ろう……！
私と【アルケス錬金堂】のみんななら
きっとできるよ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text:
…Hey, Nozomi.
Why are you splitting us up?
If you're going to say that, it should be... us at the Alces Atelier… right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちょっとノゾミ。
なんで分けちゃうのよ。
それをいうなら。
……私たち
【アルケス錬金堂】……
でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text:
…Hehe. That's our guild master for you.
You said something good.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ。
さすがうちのギルマス。
良いこと言うじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Nozomi-chan is with us too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん！
ノゾミちゃんも一緒だよ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
…Everyone, thank you.
Okay, one more time...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……みんな、
ありがとう。
じゃあ
もう一回……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: We can definitely win because we're the Alces Atelier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たち【アルケス錬金堂】なら
絶対に勝てる！
